judgement.reason: Mealie supports PostgreSQL and its local file storage for recipe images is a contained change, so DEPLOYABLE_WITH_CHANGES is appropriate.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME $MEALIE_HOME/data/ (docker/Dockerfile), volume mealie-data:/app/data/ (docker/docker-compose.yml mealie)
reviews.reason: Although DB_ENGINE can select PostgreSQL, Mealie's data directory also holds uploaded recipe images, backups and other user files, and no shown line moves them to S3 or another store.
